name: iCloud Mail
description: Search iCloud mail, save mailbox drafts, send replies and handle selected attachments with an app-specific password.
examples: Find unread mail in my iCloud inbox from the last seven days.
Draft a reply to the latest project email and save it in my iCloud mailbox.
List this email's attachments and download the PDF I select to my session folder.

zh-CN.name: iCloud 邮箱
zh-CN.description: 通过应用专用密码查询 iCloud 邮件，保存邮箱草稿、发送回复和处理选定附件。
examples: 查找 iCloud 收件箱最近七天的未读邮件。
为最新的项目邮件起草回复，保存到 iCloud 草稿箱。
列出这封邮件的附件，将选定的 PDF 下载到会话目录。
